Beautiful colonial home nestled on almost an acre of park like property. This home has been meticulously maintained and updated,hardwood floors can be found throughout under the carpeting. The large formal living room has windows on both sides and lets the natural light flood this space all day. The brick wood burning fireplace is perfect to relax by during the winter months. The family room is also generous in size and features built in bookshelves,exposed beams & French doos leading out to the tiered deck. The kitchen features Corian countertops,hardwood floors & a pantry. All the bathrooms were completely renovated in 2008. The second floor features the master suite with plenty of closet space, hardwood floors and master bath. There are three additional bedrooms all with hardwood flooring and hall bath with granite countertops. There is a small room that could serve as an office or walk in closet. Excellent commuter location! just minutes to Woodbury Commons and Woodbury Recreation.
